items.author: Swati Khandelwal

items.title: New CSS Attacks Can Break Webmail Defenses to Steal Passwords and Tokens
items.summary: New research shows content inside an email can escape its message boundary and interfere with the webmail interface. Across attack chains spanning Outlook, Gmail, Fastmail, Proton Mail, Yahoo Mail, and AOL Mail, the techniques can capture passwords, take over third-party accounts
items.author: Swati Khandelwal
